scope: Final plan-only closure audit of the current repository snapshot, specializing in evidence claims and provenance. Reviewed PLAN.md, README.md, docs/state-transition-manifests.md, requirements traceability, round-3 resolution and all four round-3 closure reviews, all round-2 reviews and resolution, the relevant round-1 resolution memos, and the named repository-agent-operating-system evidence artifacts. The explicit user scope that no implementation exists was accepted; future proof gates were checked as contracts, not required to have passed.
strengths: PLAN.md is evidence-honest at the authoritative contract level: it calls the 2026-09-12 cutoff an intended scope boundary, makes no UTC collection-history claim for the legacy corpus, distinguishes structural from semantic/provenance validation, and blocks Increment 1 on a fresh immutable re-fetch plus human review.

The 37-file inventory is reproducible: filesystem enumeration yields 14 self-managing-software, 10 RAOS base, 8 lifecycle-extension, and 5 domain-extension JSON results; all parse; all 37 current SHA-256 values match research-manifest.json; and synthesis-coverage.md has 37 distinct track entries with the same 14/10/8/5 breakdown.

The regenerated material claim graph closes ROAD-EVID-R3-002 mechanically. Its PLAN.md and normative-manifest digests match the current bytes; all 20 claim excerpts match their stated current lines; canonical work IDs are unique; all 36 evidence edges use supports, refutes, or context_only; all references resolve; and all 25 SourceObservation IDs, JSON pointers, record hashes, and result-file hashes reproduce exactly. Five explicit refutes edges preserve material conflicts.

The claim graph clearly marks semantic entailment and legacy provenance as unverified, separates platform/standard/external findings and architecture inferences from local target outcome hypotheses, treats the METR paper/blog as one family, and does not claim local efficacy, safety, recovery, isolation, compliance, productivity, or ROI.

Evidence-index.md now places a prominent disclaimer over legacy labels such as accessed, observed, and snapshot accessed. Evidence-cutoff.md correctly says the older UTC+08 account is an unverified process narrative rather than retrieval evidence.

findings.title: Two current provenance artifacts still assert the disclaimed UTC+08 timing narrative as fact
findings.requirement: The user requires evidence-honest provenance with no semantic/provenance overclaim and reproduction of the round-3 evidence closures. ROAD-EVID-R3-001 required all legacy timing claims to be labeled unverified, and the current authoritative plan says no UTC collection account is asserted.
evidence: research/repository-agent-operating-system/evidence-cutoff.md:5 says the earlier association of the dates with a UTC+08 host is an unverified process narrative and that no actual UTC retrieval time or pre-cutoff compliance is asserted.

research/repository-agent-operating-system/synthesis-coverage.md:11 nevertheless says records show 2026-09-13 'because that is the UTC+08 host’s local calendar date.' This is a causal collection-history assertion, not an explicitly unverified account.

research/repository-agent-operating-system/research-manifest.json provenance_disclaimer.access_date_scope says access_date 2026-09-13 'is intended as the UTC+08 host local calendar date' and attributes that statement to evidence-cutoff.md, although the latter now expressly disclaims that association as verified fact.

The same synthesis-coverage.md sentence says mutable pages require 'implementation-time snapshotting,' while PLAN.md:4,82,480,484 and 559 require the fresh immutable run and human review before implementation/Increment 1.
findings.reproduction: Search the six named current evidence artifacts for 'UTC+08'. Compare synthesis-coverage.md:11 and research-manifest.json provenance_disclaimer.access_date_scope with evidence-cutoff.md:5 and PLAN.md:4. The first two retain affirmative UTC+08 language; the controlling documents say that exact account is unverified and that no UTC collection account is asserted. Then compare synthesis-coverage.md:11's 'implementation-time snapshotting' with PLAN.md's pre-implementation gate.
findings.impact: The current evidence package gives incompatible answers about what the 2026-09-13 labels mean and when repair may occur. A reader can still treat the UTC+08 story as established collection history or defer snapshot repair into implementation. This is the material provenance overclaim ROAD-EVID-R3-001 required the combined deliverable to remove, so the claimed round-3 closure is not complete.
findings.recommendation: In synthesis-coverage.md and research-manifest.json, replace the affirmative UTC+08 explanation with wording that it is only an unverified legacy process narrative and that the labels establish no host timezone, UTC retrieval time, or cutoff compliance. Change 'implementation-time snapshotting' to the exact pre-implementation fresh immutable re-fetch and human semantic-review gate. Keep quoted historical text clearly marked as superseded where retained.
findings.verification: A repository-wide search of the current, non-historical provenance artifacts must find no affirmative UTC+08 causal account. evidence-cutoff.md, research-manifest.json, synthesis-coverage.md, evidence-index.md, evidence-repair.md, material-claims.json, and PLAN.md must consistently state that legacy timing is unverified and that the fresh immutable run blocks Increment 1.
